rdfs:label: ObjectProperty
rdfs:comment: An OWL property whose values are individuals (other resources, identified by IRI or blank node) — never literal strings, numbers, or dates.
notes: Examples: `foaf:knows`, `as:actor`, `dcterms:creator`. Distinct from `owl:DatatypeProperty` (whose values are literals like "Alice" or 42). The split helps reasoners and tooling — an ObjectProperty value is a resource (IRI or blank node) that can carry its own triples; a DatatypeProperty value is a literal.

history.note: Example now foaf:knows (the Actor class is not registered); notes no longer claim values are dereferenceable.
